title: Weather Watch ABC
hook: Weather watching starts with what is really there.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: clean 3D weather storybook, sky blue with sun cloud and rain accents, friendly rounded objects, high contrast

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child keeping a supervised one-day weather notebook
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: light 4/4 notebook pulse with small forecast pauses
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written observational log; natural phenomena, clothing, and instruments keep distinct roles
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: observation cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe weather gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. glockenspiel or marimba weather-signals after the word, with percussion ducking on onset
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: glockenspiel or marimba weather-signals after the word, with percussion ducking on onset
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Write a one-day weather watch where the child records what can be seen, felt, or measured from morning dew to night sky, separating observation from instrument reading.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A forecast notebook moves through time: morning surface clues, daytime cloud/wind changes, storm possibilities, evening cooling, then night sky.
forbiddenGenericLanguage: look at the sky with me
